stories.title: Saudi athletes Mustafa, Al-Bashir win bronze in karate at Nagoya Asian Games

en.title: Saudi athletes Mustafa, Al-Bashir win bronze in karate at Nagoya Asian Games
en.summary: Saudi karate athletes Dina Mustafa and Saud Al-Bashir secured bronze medals at the 20th Asian Games in Nagoya. Mustafa made history as the first Saudi female athlete to win a women's medal for the Kingdom at the Asian Games.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Ben-Gvir’s storming of Al-Aqsa as ‘blatant violation’

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Ben-Gvir's storming of Al-Aqsa as 'blatant violation'
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Ministry condemned Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir's entry into the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound with settlers, describing it as a violation and provocation to Muslims worldwide. The ministry stated the action occurred under Israeli security force protection.

stories.title: France vows response after Iran closes language centre in Tehran

en.title: France vows response after Iran closes language centre in Tehran
en.summary: Iran closed a French language centre linked to the French embassy, alleging illegal activities. France responded with strong objections to the closure.

stories.title: Saudi basalt named an international heritage stone

en.title: Saudi basalt named an international heritage stone
en.summary: The International Union of Geological Sciences approved recognition of volcanic basalt from Saudi Arabia's lava fields as an international heritage stone, marking a first for the Kingdom. The geological survey documented the stone's scientific, historical, and cultural significance to western Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: UN chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: UN chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres strongly condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and civilian areas, calling them unacceptable and emphasizing the need to protect freedom of navigation in the Bab El-Mandeb Strait.

stories.title: Arab states rally behind Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks

en.title: Arab states rally behind Saudi Arabia after Houthi attacks
en.summary: Arab organizations and officials expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia following recent Houthi attacks, condemning them as violations of international law and threats to regional security during UN General Assembly discussions.

stories.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Houthi Militia Attack Targeting Riyadh

en.title: Arab Parliament Condemns Houthi Militia Attack Targeting Riyadh
en.summary: The Arab Parliament issued a condemnation of a Houthi militia attack directed at Riyadh.

stories.title: UN, GCC chiefs condemn Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying serious threat to regional security

en.title: UN, GCC chiefs condemn Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying serious threat to regional security
en.summary: The UN Secretary General and GCC Secretary General condemned Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia targeting civilian sites, characterizing them as a severe threat to regional peace and security.

stories.title: Saudi FM Highlights Saudi Arabia’s Commitment to International Peace and Security

en.title: Saudi FM Highlights Saudi Arabia's Commitment to International Peace and Security
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister emphasized the country's dedication to international peace and security.

stories.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Multiple Arab nations and Islamic organizations condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including a ballistic missile attempt on Riyadh and strikes on civilian areas. Yemen, Kuwait, Egypt, Bahrain, Lebanon, and Jordan issued statements expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The UN Security Council issued a condemnation of Houthi attacks directed at Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: UNSC condemns Houthi attacks; affirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia in confronting aggression

en.title: UNSC condemns Houthi attacks; affirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia in confronting aggression
en.summary: The UN Security Council condemned attacks by Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia and expressed solidarity with the kingdom's right to self-defense under international law.

stories.title: ‎SPIMACO: Qassim Medical’s Nomu listing plan ‘at early stage’

en.title: SPIMACO: Qassim Medical's Nomu listing plan 'at early stage'
en.summary: SPIMACO's CFO stated that procedures for listing subsidiary Qassim Medical Services on the Nomu-Parallel Market remain in early stages, with the first step requiring shareholder approval from the majority-owned company.

stories.title: ‎Building permits in Saudi Arabia hit 5,828 in July

en.title: Building permits in Saudi Arabia hit 5,828 in July
en.summary: Saudi Arabia issued 5,828 building permits in July 2026, representing a 4 percent year-on-year increase and a 16 percent monthly increase from June.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 16
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange reported significant ownership changes occurring on September 16.

stories.title: ‎Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 1.1B on TASI last week

en.title: Foreign institutions net sellers of SAR 1.1B on TASI last week
en.summary: Foreign institutions sold more TASI stocks than they purchased during the week ending September 17, with net sales of approximately 1.1 billion Saudi riyals. Saudi institutional investors were net buyers during the same period.

stories.title: ‎VLCC shipping rates top $1M/day, Bahri likely to benefit

en.title: VLCC shipping rates top $1M/day, Bahri likely to benefit
en.summary: Very Large Crude Carrier shipping rates have reached record levels, exceeding $1 million per day on major Middle Eastern routes to Asia due to increased transit risks and limited vessel availability. Saudi shipping company Bahri is positioned to benefit from these elevated rates.
